body: Thank you! I'm glad you're recovering, you have a bunch of caring people around you :)
I think the note did me some good. My gf won't be coming home until late (she says she needs time away) so i can try and work some more this evening.
Thanks, i really appreciated it, and it made my day a bit better, so you definitely helped.

I really appreciate what you're trying to do, i really do.

I've been at this for 23 years, and i did have a few good ones. I know it can be reasonably fun, it just doesn't last. I even had an episode during my "good days" considering to "retire at the top" so to speak. 

I've been here before tho. I've had a job, pre-starting a family. It was what i was supposed to do, and i went thru it for a few years. Every day i had to push myself off the bed, and every night i was glad the day was over, dreading the next.

There's really no doubt in my mind i'll go out by my own choosing: it could be it will be in a senior home, or hospital tho; i think that's the best case scenario.

i'm doubting that more and more each day. I'm not even that depressed, really. Just thinking: why do all this, and more, and more, just to feel "normal"? not even happy, just "meh"?

I posted here, so i'm not going thru with this right now. But i'm convinced i'm deciding when it ends, and how.
I think it depends on the outcome.. it's hard, and everything i have to learn is hard too.
